API ReferenceZIdentity APIUsersUsers Ops Update
Users Ops Update
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/users/:id

Updates the details of an existing user based on the provided user ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the user that needs to be updated.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
loginName
string
REQUIRED

Unique login name of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

displayName
string
REQUIRED

Display name of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

firstName
string

First name of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

lastName
string

Last name of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

primaryEmail
string
REQUIRED

Primary email address of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

secondaryEmail
string

Secondary email address of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

department
object
status
boolean
REQUIRED

Whether the API user needs to be active true or disabled false.

customAttrsInfo
object
Responses
​
200
500

The request was successful, and the user details are updated.

Schema
Example (auto)
